reproduced_defects.title: Vehicle Escapes into Infinite Gray Void at 172 km/h
reproduced_defects.remediation_summary: Implemented 2200m regional ground boundary geofence in interactive.rs clamping position and deflecting velocity inward.

reproduced_defects.title: Aircraft Airborne Spawn at Zero Airspeed Causes Deep Stall at 16m MSL
reproduced_defects.remediation_summary: Initialized safe forward flying airspeed (75 m/s airliner, 42 m/s GA) on airborne spawn in aviation.rs.

reproduced_defects.title: Train Consist Spawns Floating in Bay Water Without Railway Tracks
reproduced_defects.remediation_summary: Guarded train spawning against missing rail infrastructure in interactive.rs; falls back to Car mode with user notification.

reproduced_defects.title: HyperSport RR-1000 Constructed from Crude Primitive Boxes
reproduced_defects.remediation_summary: Redesigned LOD0 chassis with aerodynamic fairings, biplane winglets, sculpted tank, trellis frame, 4-pipe exhaust (2,224 triangles).

reproduced_defects.title: TransContinental Semi 53ft Trailer is an Untextured Monolithic Box
reproduced_defects.remediation_summary: Upgraded 53ft trailer with 26 corrugated side ribs per side, dual swing doors, ICC bumper, landing gear (1,792 triangles).

reproduced_defects.title: Distributed Platform Archives Missing Compiled Binaries or Containing Stubs
reproduced_defects.remediation_summary: Truth in advertising enforced: Linux, macOS, iOS, Android marked BLOCKED; production certification revoked until native toolchains compile true binaries.
